title: Cross-face reverse-bound matching: the F4 list-LB (n^{(k+1)/2}) and the F2/F5 4th-moment period-LB (sqrt n) are the SAME tower-word floor
evidence: Exact integer probes at proper-subgroup prize primes (n in {8,16,32,64}, q~n^4, mu_n a PROPER subgroup, -1 in mu_n). scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C078{,_b,_c}.py. (1) The moment-identity bridge is EXACT: sum_b |eta_b|^4 = q*E_2(G) verified (168.0 vs 168 at n=8,q=4129) -- this genuinely links the F2/F5 period face to additive energy. (2) The F4 supply floor is TIGHT in-regime: zero-sum 4-SETS = C(n/2,2) exactly (6,28,120 at n=8,16,32), so evenSupply_ge_choose's C(n/2,j) reverse bound is real and sharp. BUT the central 'SAME diagonal/antipodal origin' claim is FALSE: the F2/F5 period floor uses E_2(G) >= |G|^2, which is the TRIVIAL DIAGONAL (ordered solutions a+b=a+b, count 2|G|^2-|G|; verified exactly) and holds for ANY set with NO negation/antipodal structure -- negation-closure is irrelevant to it. The F4 supply floor C(n/2,j) counts ANTIPODAL negation-pair zero-sum SETS and genuinely needs -1 in mu_n. The off-diagonal energy (where antipodal contributions live) is exactly n^2-2n (verified) and is NOT what the period LB invokes. The floors also do not match numerically: at r=2 the supply floor is Theta(n^2) (a COUNT), while the 4th-moment worst-period^2 LB is 2.6-2.9*|G| = Theta(n) (a MAGNITUDE => sqrt n); the connection conflates a Theta(n^j) count with a Theta(sqrt n) magnitude. So the two reverse bounds are real but descend from DIFFERENT structures (antipodal-negation vs trivial-diagonal) and do NOT share a matching floor.
reduced_to: Both reverse bounds saturate at the Johnson floor (period ~ sqrt n; supply ~ C(n/2,j) is a count, not cancellation) and neither reaches budget n. Pushing the PERIOD bound past sqrt n requires the OFF-DIAGONAL energy (n^2-2n term, the antipodal/non-trivial part) to beat the trivial diagonal |G|^2 -- i.e. BGK sqrt-cancellation among the (p-1)/n Gauss-sum phases. The antipodal supply count does NOT feed this: it is a set-count Theta(n^j), orthogonal to the max-vs-sum gap that caps the worst period. Sharpened open statement: bound max_{b!=0} ||eta_b||^2 using only the off-diagonal energy E_2 - (2|G|^2-|G|) = n^2-2n, which is exactly the BGK/Paley wall.
wall: W-Johnson / BGK sqrt-cancellation (the off-diagonal-energy-beats-trivial-diagonal core; 25-year-open Paley Graph Conjecture for thin mu_n).
honest_note: Both reverse bounds ARE in-tree, axiom-clean, and genuine (verified by reading SupplyForcingLowerBound.lean, EvenTowerSupplyGrowth.lean, WorstPeriodLowerBound.lean and reproducing their floors exactly). The moment identity sum_b|eta_b|^{2r}=q E_r is a real bridge. What is REFUTED is the connection's claim that the two floors share the SAME diagonal/antipodal origin and 'match' -- they do not: period-LB origin = trivial diagonal (negation-free), supply-LB origin = antipodal negation pairs, and one is a Theta(n^j) count vs the other a Theta(sqrt n) magnitude. The 'structural asymmetry explanation' the connection advertises rests on this misidentification. No progress on the core (welds to BGK). Not a closure. The mis-match finding (trivial-diagonal vs antipodal) is worth a one-line note in DISPROOF_LOG as a guard against re-attempting 'antipodal supply feeds period cancellation'. Probes use n<=64, q~n^4 (the n<<sqrt q prize geometry); the moment-identity check was numerically verified only at n=8 (q<=20000 feasibility cap) but is a known exact identity.
